resources.string: Step 4 · Check the result and permissions
Open the binding screen in DSH on the computer you want to bind and start a request. Paste the request ID and binding code shown on the computer into the fields below. Do not paste a URL.
The confirmation status below is from the last verified request details. It does not mean the current check has finished.
No usable grant found in the last check
Choose a workspace and assistant preset that the computer allows. Check the original request to confirm the creation result. Current read permission must still be checked before the session opens.
Only verified, authorized workspaces for this runtime are listed. Their names are not file paths on your phone.
Only presets provided by the computer are listed. The phone does not display or edit model credentials.
This runtime has no authorized workspace available for session creation. Check the settings and permissions on the computer or with your administrator, then refresh the options.
This runtime has no assistant presets. Set up an assistant on the computer, then refresh the options.
Choose a workspace and an assistant preset before creating a session. Unsubmitted selections are kept only while you are in this flow.
Your previous choices are no longer among the verified options. Choose again before creating the session.
Session creation options could not be fetched from the computer right now. Workspaces may still exist. Go back or refresh when the connection returns.
This account does not have permission to create sessions. Go back to check your sign-in or contact your administrator. You cannot submit using old options.
Waiting to verify the creation options for this runtime. Old options will not be used to create a session.
Search by workspace name or ID
No matches. Try a different search.
The original request may already have created a session. Check it first. Another session will be created only if you explicitly choose to start a new request.
Background alerts are optional. You can still view and reply in authorized online sessions if push is not configured, FCM is unavailable, or system notifications are off.
Registration is valid until %1$s. Individual alerts may not be delivered or read.
No alert references are shown yet. There may still be pending items. Check current requests in authorized online sessions.
This list shows only received alert references, not all pending items across your sessions. Marking an alert as read does not resolve the request.
Current version %1$s (version code not yet verified)
A completed download or verified package does not mean the update is installed. Check the installed version to confirm the result.
No release notes were provided for this version.
Verify the computer and full fingerprint
Once binding is complete, this account will receive owner permissions for this runtime.
I verified the details above and the full fingerprint on the computer
If the result is unknown, check the original request first. Reconnecting will not automatically create another session.
